items.title: A Healer Is Born
items.caption: Born beneath starlight on August 12, 1996 — the opening verse of a fearless healer's song and a budding emergency medicine sorcerer.

items.title: Starts Schooling at Girton
items.caption: June 1999: Krupa’s magical journey began at Girton, where her first lessons were sprinkled with stardust and curiosity.

items.title: Eighth Kyu — Courage in Practice
items.caption: On March 11, 2004 she earned her eighth kyu — a brave, starlit stance that reads like a bridge in a fearless anthem.

items.title: Starts 3rd Standard at J B Vaccha
items.caption: June 2004: she moved to J B Vaccha for 3rd standard, carrying her courage like a spellbook full of new chapters.

items.title: Starts Schooling at SBOA Model
items.caption: Early 2005: Krupa began at SBOA Model, continuing her story with bright ambition and a fearless heart.

items.title: Top of the Class — 10th Triumph
items.caption: June 2012: Krupa aced her 10th like a chart-topping chorus — bright, bold, and unafraid to shimmer.

items.title: Graduation — The Junior College Verse
items.caption: June 2014: she finished 12th with poise, a gentle refrain before the louder anthems of medicine.

items.title: MBBS Complete — White Coat Moment
items.caption: February 2020 marked the day she completed MBBS — a white-coat crescendo, diploma in hand and a brave new chorus of clinical nights ahead.

items.title: Joined Apollo — The Hospital Chapter
items.caption: In August 2020 she joined Apollo, stepping into bustling wards and heroic shifts that read like verses from a resilient anthem.

items.title: MRCEM — Senior Residency
items.caption: 2023 saw Krupa claim MRCEM and rise to senior residency — equal parts grit, glory, and midnight shifts that read like verses from a brave ballad.

items.title: FRCEM — Junior Consultant
items.caption: In 2026 she earned FRCEM and stepped into consultant life — the chorus swelling, a confident new stanza in her career anthem.

items.title: Engagement — A Promise in a Magical Era
items.caption: May 18, 2026: Akshay and Krupa said yes to forever, a sparkling engagement moment written like a spellbinding duet.

items.title: Krupashree Aces the OET
items.caption: July 11: Krupashree charmed the OET like a soaring chorus — her voice steady, her confidence fearless.

items.title: Akshay and Krupa get their photos taken at Janal
items.caption: On July 14, 2026, Akshay and Krupa posed together at Janal like a pair of storybook champions, capturing a bright new chapter.

items.title: Krupa visits Rameshwaram
items.caption: On July 27, Krupa journeyed to Rameshwaram like a traveling physician of light, breathing magic into every coastal breeze.
